name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
description: Balance, humility, and hard-won hope — lines from Aang, Uncle Iroh, and the rest of Team Avatar.
author: Quips Editorial

quotes.content: Water. Earth. Fire. Air. My grandmother used to tell me stories about the old days: a time of peace when the Avatar kept balance between the Water Tribes, Earth Kingdom, Fire Nation and Air Nomads. But that all changed when the Fire Nation attacked.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E1 'The Boy in the Iceberg' (2005)
quotes.notes: The opening narration of the series, spoken by Katara over the title sequence of the very first episode.

quotes.content: But the true secret, is in the gooey center.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E3 'The Southern Air Temple' (2005)
quotes.notes: Gyatso teaching a young Aang to make fruit pies in a flashback at the Southern Air Temple.

quotes.content: It is the strength of your hearts that make you who you are.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E6 'Imprisoned' (2005)
quotes.notes: From Katara's rallying speech to the captive earthbenders aboard the Fire Nation rig.

quotes.content: You can't sacrifice an entire division like that! Those soldiers love and defend our nation! How can you betray them?
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E12 'The Storm' (2005)
quotes.notes: The outburst in the war room, shown in flashback, that led to Zuko's Agni Kai with his father and his banishment.

quotes.content: Fire is alive! It breathes, it grows.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E16 'The Deserter' (2005)
quotes.notes: The deserter firebending master warning Aang why fire cannot be taught to a student who is not ready.

quotes.content: I've always had to struggle and fight and that's made me strong. It's made me who I am.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E20 'The Siege of the North, Part 2' (2005)
quotes.notes: Zuko speaking to the unconscious Aang in a blizzard cave, comparing his own path to Azula's effortless talent.

quotes.content: Neutral jing is the key to earthbending. It involves listening and waiting for the right moment to strike.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E3 'Return to Omashu' (2006)
quotes.notes: Bumi, from inside his metal coffin, telling Aang what kind of earthbending teacher to look for.

quotes.content: You must never give in to despair. Allow yourself to slip down that road and you surrender to your lowest instincts. In the darkest times, hope is something you give yourself. That is the meaning of inner strength.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E5 'Avatar Day' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh answering Zuko after Zuko says there is no hope at all; the full line opens 'No, Zuko!'

quotes.content: Boomerang! You do always come back!
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E5 'Avatar Day' (2006)
quotes.notes: Sokka's cry of joy when his boomerang returns mid-fight to save him during the trial at Chin Village.

quotes.content: Never give up without a fight.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E7 'Zuko Alone' (2006)
quotes.notes: Young Zuko reading aloud the inscription on the pearl dagger Iroh sent home from the siege of Ba Sing Se.

quotes.content: Sharing tea with a fascinating stranger is one of life's true delights.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E8 'The Chase' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh to Toph, after she joins him for tea at his roadside campfire.

quotes.content: There is nothing wrong with letting the people who love you help you.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E8 'The Chase' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh to Toph in the same scene, telling her she sounds like his nephew; he follows it with 'Not that I love you, I just met you.'

quotes.content: The key to earthbending is your stance. You've got to be steady and strong. Rock is a stubborn element. If you're going to move it, you've got to be like a rock yourself.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E9 'Bitter Work' (2006)
quotes.notes: Toph's first lesson to Aang as his earthbending teacher.

quotes.content: It is important to draw wisdom from many different places. If you take it from only one place, it becomes rigid and stale.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E9 'Bitter Work' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh explaining to Zuko why he studies the other three elements before teaching him to redirect lightning.

quotes.content: Prince Zuko, pride is not the opposite of shame, but its source. True humility is the only antidote to shame.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E9 'Bitter Work' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh diagnosing why Zuko cannot generate lightning: the turmoil inside him.

quotes.content: Drink cactus juice. It'll quench ya! Nothing's quenchier. It's the quenchiest!
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E11 'The Desert' (2006)
quotes.notes: Sokka hallucinating in the Si Wong Desert after drinking cactus juice.

quotes.content: This tea is nothing more than hot leaf juice!
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E14 'City of Walls and Secrets' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh's verdict on the tea served at the Ba Sing Se shop where he and Zuko are put to work.

quotes.content: The secret ingredient is love.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E14 'City of Walls and Secrets' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh's answer, in the same scene, when asked what makes his tea so good.

quotes.content: Life happens wherever you are, whether you make it or not.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E14 'City of Walls and Secrets' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh urging Zuko to stop waiting for his old life to resume and live the one in front of him.

quotes.content: It's time for you to look inward and begin asking yourself the big questions. Who are you, and what do you want?
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E17 'Lake Laogai' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh begging Zuko to give up the hunt for the Avatar, after Zuko says he wants his destiny.

quotes.content: I am the greatest earthbender in the world! Don't you two dunderheads ever forget it!
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E19 'The Guru' (2006)
quotes.notes: Toph's declaration after inventing metalbending to escape the metal box Xin Fu and Master Yu trapped her in.

quotes.content: We're all connected. Everything is connected.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E19 'The Guru' (2006)
quotes.notes: Aang opening his chakras with Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple.

quotes.content: Sometimes, life is like this dark tunnel. You can't always see the light at the end of the tunnel, but if you just keep moving, you will come to a better place.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E20 'The Crossroads of Destiny' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh to Aang in the crystal catacombs beneath Ba Sing Se, when Aang asks how he can face what is coming.

quotes.content: You're not the man you used to be, Zuko. You are stronger and wiser and freer than you have ever been. And now you have come to the crossroads of your destiny. It's time for you to choose. It's time for you to choose good.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E20 'The Crossroads of Destiny' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh's plea to Zuko in the catacombs, at the moment the season's title turns on Zuko's decision.

quotes.content: Perfection and power are overrated. I think you were very wise to choose happiness and love.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E20 'The Crossroads of Destiny' (2006)
quotes.notes: Iroh to Aang, after Aang gives up the Avatar State rather than let go of his attachment to Katara.

quotes.content: I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E3 'The Painted Lady' (2007)
quotes.notes: Katara refusing to leave the poisoned river village of Jang Hui, even at risk to the group's cover.

quotes.content: The way of the sword doesn't belong to any one nation. Knowledge of the arts belongs to us all.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E4 'Sokka's Master' (2007)
quotes.notes: Piandao's answer after Sokka confesses he is Water Tribe, not Fire Nation; the master trains him anyway.

quotes.content: My own mother thought I was a monster. She was right, of course, but it still hurt.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E5 'The Beach' (2007)
quotes.notes: Azula's confession around the bonfire on Ember Island, the closest the series comes to seeing her vulnerable.

quotes.content: Some friendships are so strong, they can even transcend lifetimes.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E6 'The Avatar and the Fire Lord' (2007)
quotes.notes: Roku telling Aang about his friendship with Fire Lord Sozin, and about Aang's own with Monk Gyatso.

quotes.content: Evil and good are always at war inside you, Zuko. It is your nature, your legacy.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E6 'The Avatar and the Fire Lord' (2007)
quotes.notes: Iroh, in a letter-like flashback conversation, explaining why Zuko's family history is his own inner battle.

quotes.content: I am going to speak my mind, and you are going to listen.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E11 'The Day of Black Sun, Part 2: The Eclipse' (2007)
quotes.notes: Zuko confronting Fire Lord Ozai during the solar eclipse, before renouncing him and joining the Avatar.

quotes.content: Hello ... Zuko here.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E12 'The Western Air Temple' (2008)
quotes.notes: Zuko rehearsing his introduction to Team Avatar on a badgerfrog before asking to join them.

quotes.content: Destiny is a funny thing. You never know how things are going to work out. But if you keep an open mind, and an open heart, I promise you will find your own destiny someday.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E12 'The Western Air Temple' (2008)
quotes.notes: Iroh's words to Zuko, recalled in flashback as Zuko decides to seek out the Avatar as an ally.

quotes.content: The past can be a great teacher.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E13 'The Firebending Masters' (2008)
quotes.notes: Aang to Zuko as they explore the ruins of the Sun Warriors' civilization looking for the origins of firebending.

quotes.content: My first girlfriend turned into the moon.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E14 'The Boiling Rock, Part 1' (2008)
quotes.notes: Sokka commiserating with Zuko about Yue during a break at the Boiling Rock prison.

quotes.content: That's rough, buddy.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E14 'The Boiling Rock, Part 1' (2008)
quotes.notes: Zuko's reply, after a long pause and a glance at the sky, to Sokka's line about his first girlfriend.

quotes.content: I love Zuko more than I fear you.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E15 'The Boiling Rock, Part 2' (2008)
quotes.notes: Mai to Azula, after betraying her to save Zuko at the Boiling Rock.

quotes.content: Forgiveness is the first step you have to take to begin healing.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E16 'The Southern Raiders' (2008)
quotes.notes: Aang to Katara after she confronts the Fire Nation soldier who killed her mother and chooses not to kill him.

quotes.content: Only justice will bring peace.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E19 'Sozin's Comet, Part 2: The Old Masters' (2008)
quotes.notes: Kyoshi's counsel to Aang when he asks his past lives how to deal with Fire Lord Ozai.

quotes.content: Selfless duty calls you to sacrifice your own spiritual needs, and do whatever it takes to protect the world.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E19 'Sozin's Comet, Part 2: The Old Masters' (2008)
quotes.notes: Yangchen, the Air Nomad Avatar before Kuruk, telling Aang the Avatar cannot detach from the world.

quotes.content: The monks always taught me that all life is sacred. Even the life of the tiniest spider-fly caught in its own web.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E19 'Sozin's Comet, Part 2: The Old Masters' (2008)
quotes.notes: Aang's objection to Yangchen, stating the Air Nomad principle he refuses to abandon in defeating Ozai.

quotes.content: It's a lovely night for a walk. Why don't you join me? It would clear your head. Or just stay in your room and sit in the dark. Whatever makes you happy.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E18 'The Waterbending Master' (2005)
quotes.notes: Iroh leaning into Zuko's cabin after the crew mutiny, answering his nephew's sulking with an open invitation and a shrug.

quotes.content: You're just a jerk without a soul, no offense!
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E19 'The Siege of the North, Part 1' (2005)
quotes.notes: Sokka tackling Hahn after he brags that marrying Princess Yue comes with 'perks'; it gets Sokka thrown off the mission.

quotes.content: You rise with the moon. I rise with the sun.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S1E19 'The Siege of the North, Part 1' (2005)
quotes.notes: Zuko to Katara in the Spirit Oasis at daybreak, after the sunrise melts the ice she trapped him in and their duel turns.

quotes.content: The stars sure are beautiful tonight. Too bad you can't see them, Toph!
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E8 'The Chase' (2006)
quotes.notes: Katara's mocking jab at Toph from her sleeping bag, at the height of their feud over camp chores.

quotes.content: That's a sharp outfit, Chan. Careful. You could puncture the hull of an empire-class Fire Nation battleship, leaving thousands to drown at sea, because it's so sharp.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E5 'The Beach' (2007)
quotes.notes: Azula's attempt at flirting at Chan's Ember Island party, delivered with a straight face and no idea why it lands badly.

quotes.content: Zuko, you have to look within yourself to save yourself from your other self. Only then will your true self reveal itself.
quotes.source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S3E12 'The Western Air Temple' (2008)
quotes.notes: Zuko impersonating Uncle Iroh while rehearsing his pitch to Team Avatar, then admitting he can't figure out what it means.
